payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the Sentence Reordering (SR) task is the most effective among the three pre-training tasks for improving performance in abstractive summarization.

claims.text: Sentence Reordering (SR) is the most effective pre-training task, achieving the highest ROUGE-2 scores on both CNN/DailyMail and New York Times datasets.
Using all three tasks together (SR, NSG, MDG) generally outperforms using them individually, but SR still shows the best performance overall.
